source_text.body:
Run personal errands like flowers and date nights
Marshall Haas used Meta's Muse agent for personal tasks, including buying flowers and booking date nights.
·
Sep 8, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
Marshall received early access to Meta's Muse agent. The agent paid his bills, bought flowers, and booked date nights with no further details given on access, steps, or human intervention.
How it went
He found it genuinely impressive and said it just works, calling it what OpenClaw should have been.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Handle a personal errand for me: [buy flowers for name to be delivered on date / book a date night on date at a cuisine restaurant in city]. Find two or three options within [budget], recommend one, and tell me why. Before you pay or confirm any booking, show me the final details and wait for my OK.
Original source: https://x.com/marshal/status/2097414842844151842
